text.A: **See poliitika kehtib olenemata sellest, kus te asute.** Järgime Ühendkuningriigi andmekaitseõigust ning kui kohaldub ka selle riigi andmekaitseõigus, kus te elate, järgime ka seda.
text.B: **Allergia- ja toitumismärkused.** Edastame need koos teie tellimusega toiduautole ega kasuta neid millekski muuks. Eemaldame need koos teie nime ja kontaktandmetega 12 kuud pärast tellimust (vt jaotis 7).
text.C: **Rahvusvahelised edastamised.** Teie kontoandmeid ja tellimuste andmeid säilitatakse ja töödeldakse Ühendkuningriigis. Mõnda toimingut tehakse väljaspool seda: menüüde väljalugemine ja WhatsAppi automaatsed vastused, mis kasutavad Google’i teenust Ameerika Ühendriikides; WhatsAppi sõnumite edastamine, mida teeb Meta Ameerika Ühendriikides; maksed, mida töötleb Stripe Ameerika Ühendriikides; ning tõuketeavitused, mida edastavad Apple ja Google Ameerika Ühendriikides. Kui andmed lahkuvad Ühendkuningriigist, on edastamine kaetud Ühendkuningriigi piisavusotsustega (UK adequacy regulations) või dokumendiga International Data Transfer Agreement (rahvusvahelise andmeedastuse leping) või Addendum (lisa) ning, kui teie riigi õigus seda nõuab, kaitsemeetmega, mida see õigus tunnustab. Võite küsida meilt teavet kohaldatavate kaitsemeetmete kohta.
text.G:
Meie [teenusetingimused](/terms) kehtivad igas riigis, kus HatchGrabi kasutatakse. Mõnes riigis kehtivad lisareeglid. Sellel lehel on need esitatud riikide kaupa.

Kui mõni allpool olev jaotis kehtib teie kohta, on see meie teenusetingimuste osa. Kui selles on sätestatud midagi neist erinevat, kehtib selle riigi puhul käesolev leht.

Kui teie riiki ei ole loetletud, lisareegleid ei ole: teenusetingimused kehtivad nii, nagu need on kirjutatud. Meie [privaatsuspoliitika](/privacy) on igas riigis sama.

back.A: **This policy applies regardless of where you are.** We follow United Kingdom data protection law, and if the data protection law of the country where you live also applies, we follow that too.
back.B: **Allergy and dietary notes.** We pass them together with your order to the food truck and do not use them for anything else. We remove them together with your name and contact details 12 months after the order (see section 7).
back.C: When data leave the United Kingdom, the transfer is covered by United Kingdom adequacy decisions (UK adequacy regulations) or by the document International Data Transfer Agreement (international data transfer agreement) or Addendum (addendum) and, if the law of your country requires it, by a safeguard that that law recognises.
back.D: ## 8. Your rights / Under United Kingdom data protection law and the law of your country of residence, if it applies, you have the right to: [7 bullets unchanged] / The law of your country of residence may give you these rights under other names, or additional rights. You have those too. / **Making a request.** Send an email to privacy@hatchgrab.com. Before acting on a request, we check that it is genuine. You can ask someone else to make the request for you, and we do not treat you differently because you made a request. We reply within one month, or sooner if the law of your country requires it. If you ordered from a food truck, we may forward your request to that food truck, because it decides how your order data are used. If we refuse a request, you can ask us to review it again by replying to our answer. / **Deleting an account.** [old text unchanged] When an operator's account is deleted, we also remove their customers' names, contact details and notes from the orders we keep. / **Marketing emails.** We send marketing emails only if the law of your country of residence allows it, which in some countries means only with your consent. Each of them states who it is from, our postal address and how to stop receiving them. If you ask us to stop sending, we do so free of charge and within 10 working days. Emails related to an order or your account are not marketing. If we or a food truck offer order updates by text message, you receive them only if you agree, and you can stop receiving them at any time. / **If something goes wrong.** If a breach relating to your personal data is likely to cause you serious harm, we notify you and the supervisory authority as soon as possible, if the law requires it, or help the food truck you ordered from to do so. / **Complaints.** Let us know about it first at privacy@hatchgrab.com; we would be grateful for the chance to put the matter right. You can also complain to the data protection authority of your country of residence. In the United Kingdom that is the Information Commissioner's Office (the UK Information Commissioner's Office), at ico.org.uk or by phone on 0303 123 1113.
back.G: Our [terms of service] apply in every country where HatchGrab is used. In some countries extra rules apply. On this page they are set out country by country. / If any section below applies to you, it is part of our terms of service. If it provides something different from them, this page applies for that country. / If your country is not listed, there are no extra rules: the terms of service apply as they are written. Our [privacy policy] is the same in every country.

notes: 'Breach' = 'isikuandmetega seotud rikkumine' (Estonian GDPR term) rather than the removed NZ part's 'privaatsusrikkumine'. 'The law of the country you live in' rendered as 'elukohariigi õigus' (law of the country of residence).
